verificationSummary: Core main commit 5892df6e542a02b25ae3b18ee02a55842b83d48f still contains the PDF renderer pilot fixture manifests, but the local Core working tree had 57 tracked deletions under packages/pdf-renderer-pilot/fixtures before this readiness pass. After explicit user approval, only packages/pdf-renderer-pilot/fixtures was restored from HEAD. Post-restore checks showed Core git status clean, deleted fixture count 0, the fixture directory containing 57 files, and font-subset-manifest.v1.json present. Core npm run check then passed type-check and Vitest with 460 test files and 2,945 tests. This evidence supports only the local Core PDF fixture state reconciliation and Core owner-gate verification after that reconciliation; it does not promote broad Core truth, renderer/export parity, production readiness, Backend readiness, Editor readiness, frontend implementation readiness, FlowDoc product readiness, or map truth.
